Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
  • Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
  • Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.


Requerimentos & Skills:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos.
  • Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop
  • Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Ad Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Solutions Engineer — Warehouse Automation & Robotics
description:

Shape the future of warehouse automation with a global leader in AMR robotics.

Our client is a global leader in Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) solutions is transforming how warehouses pick, move, and sort at scale. With rapid growth across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, our client is looking for a Solutions Engineer to help turn complex logistics challenges into intelligent, robot-driven solutions.

If you love translating operational problems into elegant automation designs, this is your role.

You'll be the technical bridge between clients and the robotics — designing tailored automation solutions and seeing them through to deployment.

  • Collaborate to deploy: Partner with WMS/WES software engineers to define requirements and ensure seamless, on-time deployments. Coordinate with contractors where robotics meet broader logistics operations.
  • Win and grow accounts: Build and deliver compelling proposals around operational benefits, ROI, and deployment roadmaps aligned with each client's growth strategy.


What you bring

  • Bachelor's in Supply Chain Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years in warehousing automation, logistics, or supply chain operations.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD 2D layout design (required).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Comfort working both independently and within a collaborative team.
  • Willingness to travel to client and project sites as needed.


Nice to have

  • Project management experience.
  • WMS/WES/WCS integration experience.
  • Full English Proficiency

title: Senior Video Editor

About trends.ceo


trends.ceo works with CEOs, executives, and senior leaders at high-trust firms.

Our work is not generic corporate video or random social clips. We help serious leaders turn their best ideas, experience, and perspective into sharp editorial video that feels credible, modern, and worth watching.

The work sits between documentary, executive communications, and premium social video. It requires strong storytelling, clean taste, and the ability to make complex business ideas feel clear and compelling.

We’re looking for a senior editor who can help us raise the creative standard.


The role


You’ll edit executive interviews and leadership content into polished short-form and mid-form videos for a business audience.

This role is for someone with strong creative direction and editorial sense. We need an editor who understands what footage to include, when to use it, how to shape pacing, where sound design matters, and how to make senior leaders look credible, natural, and engaging.


Responsibilities


Edit executive interviews into high-quality short-form and mid-form videos.

Find strong hooks, story arcs, insights, and human moments in raw footage.

Shape complex business topics into clear, compelling edits.

Make smart choices on b-roll, cutaways, pacing, music, sound design, captions, graphics, and text treatment.

Use AI tools where helpful to storyboard ideas, create simple animations, generate visual references, or support lightweight visual concepts.

Maintain a premium, modern, editorial visual style.

Work with our creative team to apply feedback quickly.

Stay organized, meet deadlines, and manage project files properly.


What we’re looking for


5+ years of professional video editing experience.

A strong portfolio with relevant interview, documentary, corporate, editorial, or premium social samples.

Excellent storytelling instincts.

Strong taste in pacing, structure, music, sound design, and visual polish.

Experience editing business, executive, documentary, or high-end interview content.

Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills.

After Effects and AI tools are a strong plus.

Comfort using AI tools as part of the creative process.

Strong English comprehension.

Reliable, organized, and comfortable working remotely.

What matters most


You can find the story inside the footage.

You know the difference between a generic clip and a strong idea.

You understand when to use b-roll, when to stay on the speaker, and when the edit needs breathing room.

You can make senior people look sharp without making the work feel overproduced.

You bring creative opinions, not just technical execution.

Application process


Please send:

Your portfolio or 3–5 relevant video samples.

A short note on your experience editing interviews or executive/business content.

Your hourly rate.

Your monthly availability.

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing test .

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung
  • Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business
  • Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas


Was wir bieten

  • Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt.
  • Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen.
  • Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen.
  • Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst.
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

    • Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung
  • Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business
  • Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas


Was wir bieten

  • Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt.
  • Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen.
  • Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen.
  • Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst.
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

    • Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

title: Senior Immigration Paralegal
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Immigration Paralegal em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Immigration Paralegal


Team Lead & Trainer — Remote — EOIR + USCIS + Federal Litigation (Bonus)


Cunha Law PLLC — a U.S. immigration law firm based in Washington, DC — is hiring a senior immigration paralegal to lead and train our paralegal team. This is a technical leadership and team-development role : you'll be the person who trains our paralegals, reviews the team's work, and makes sure every case leaves the office at the firm's standard — across both immigration court (EOIR / removal defense) and affirmative filings before USCIS.


We are not an immigration consultancy, and we don't compete with form-fillers. Every case at Cunha Law is handled as a real legal matter — eligibility analysis, case strategy, legal research, and attorney review before anything is filed. We compete with the top U.S. immigration firms, not with the paperwork mills. If that's the standard you want to build a team around, keep reading.


This is a role for someone who has real mileage and knows how to develop people. It is not an entry-level position. We're looking for someone with genuine U.S. immigration experience — comfortable both in the dynamics of immigration court and in assembling complex USCIS petitions — with the maturity to lead, train, and hold a team accountable.


What you'll do

  • Lead the paralegal team — assign cases, track the caseload, enforce deadlines, and make sure nothing is left loose
  • Train and develop the paralegals on both sides of the practice: affirmative immigration (USCIS) and removal defense (EOIR)
  • Review the team's technical work (QA) — petitions, evidence packages, forms, and letters — before final attorney review
  • Standardize processes, checklists, and SOPs to keep quality and technical consistency high across every case
  • Directly handle and supervise the most complex cases (EOIR + USCIS), serving as the team's reference point
  • Draft and review declarations, memoranda, and responses to RFEs/NOIDs in clear, well-supported legal English
  • Set and enforce an English-first standard across the team's work product and internal communication
  • Report directly to the attorney on caseload status and team development, with disciplined management in Zoho (CRM + Projects)
Note: this role is not client-facing. Your focus is the team, technical quality, and training — you work with the team and the attorney, not on the front line with clients.

Requirements (the bar is high and it doesn't drop)

  • ~5 years of U.S. immigration experience — ideally spanning both immigration court (EOIR) and USCIS petitions, Federal court is highly desirable bonus.
  • Experience leading, training, or supervising paralegals or a technical team (even informally — we want to see that you've developed people and raised a team's standard)
  • Fluent English — written and spoken — is essential and non-negotiable. You'll review and train legal-English work product and set the team's English standard.
  • Spanish is a strong plus — a Spanish-speaker can also take on Spanish-language cases directly, which adds real value to the role. Portuguese is a nice bonus but not required.
  • Command of the core USCIS forms and processes (I-130, I-485, I-765, N-400, I-589, visa petitions) and familiarity with removal-proceeding dynamics
  • Absolute rigor with deadlines, organization, and ownership that doesn't get passed off
  • Able to work 100% remote on U.S. business hours (Washington, DC time zone) , following the U.S. calendar

What we offer

  • Direct contract , 100% remote from Latin America, in a leadership role
  • Payment in U.S. dollars (USD) , monthly — commensurate with experience
  • Real investment in you: training, mentorship, top-tier systems and technology to operate at the level of a first-rate firm
  • A grown-up, respectful, process-driven environment — no micromanagement, with clarity and structure
  • We hire for talent, not pedigree. If you're excellent and bigger firms overlooked you, you're exactly who we want to talk to.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)


About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide.


As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators.


Role Overview


As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series.


This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.


Requirements


  • Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles.
  • Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting.
  • Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet.
  • Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules.
  • Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management
  • Experience working remotely with production teams


Engagement Details

  • Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote (Work from your own studio)
  • Compensation: Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis.

How to Apply : Please fill in


What happens after you apply?


Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline:

1.Internal Evaluation:

Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects.

2.Show Casting & Voice Testing:

If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision.

3.Contract & Legal Alignment:

Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms.

4.Calibration & Onboarding:

Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow.

5.Production & Monthly Deliveries:

Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month until the series is complete.

title: Head of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

Advanced English

Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:

Team & Stakeholder Leadership:


• Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers.

• Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção do grupo Omnicom, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

• Auxiliar na revisão e implementação de novos processos de submissão de materiais;

• Manter uma boa comunicação, ser proativo em sua abordagem e cultivar relacionamentos com equipes parceiras.


Requisitos necessários:

• Bacharelado em Ciências Farmacêuticas ou área da saúde.

• 2 anos ou mais de experiência em indústria farmacêutica (áreas: marketing, médica ou relacionada).

• Compreensão do processo de revisão e aprovação de material promocional.

• Capacidade de conciliar vários projetos enquanto cumpre os prazos do cliente.

• Habilidades de planejamento, resolução de problemas, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo/organização.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral.

• Fluência em inglês: leitura, interpretação de texto, escrita e fala, pois trabalhará diretamente com o time dos EUA no dia a dia.

• Altamente desejável: conhecimento do fluxo de revisão/aprovação de materiais no Veeva PromoMats, incluindo ancoragem e anotação de referências.

Na NTT DATA Business Solutions, impulsionamos a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e além, impulsionados por uma equipe global e mais de 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 nações em mais de 30 países.   • Disponibilidade; Segurança; Performance; Escalabilidade.

  • Integrações SAP e sistemas legados;
  • Performance, alta disponibilidade, segurança e continuidade operacional.
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas SAP, recomendações oficiais e padrões corporativos de arquitetura.

Requisitos:


  • Certificação SAP PCA (perfil SAP Basis).
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de Move, Migration e Upgrades SAP.
  • Atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em: SAP S/4HANA; Arquitetura SAP on‑premise, cloud e híbrida; Ambientes hyperscaler certificados SAP; Integrações SAP; Landscapes SAP, governança técnica e migração de dados.
  • Forte capacidade de análise, identificação e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Diferenciais:


  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para interação com públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Perfil consultivo, com visão end‑to‑end e forte orientação à solução.
  • Experiência prévia em pré‑vendas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos SAP de grande porte e ambientes críticos.
  • Experiência em apresentações executivas e condução de workshops técnicos.

  • C1 (Advanced) or C2 (Mastery) English fluency.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience:

Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. This person must be able to read, write and summarize at a high volume and high accuracy. The Pre-screening tests typing speed (45-60wpm), reading comprehension and pattern recognition. Accurately label machine learning data through various methods to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines.

Collaborate with team members to identify improvements to the labelling interface or labelling processes in order to drive efficiency and high-quality.

Complete assignments by deadlines while meeting team expectations and goals.

title: Head of Compliance (Brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance (Brazil resident) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
  • AML/compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA)
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB or COAF on audits, inspections, or filings

title: Head of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Finance- Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business.


The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership

  • Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity.
  • Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives.
  • Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership.

Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations.
  • Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities.
  • Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.

Treasury & Banking

  • Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships.
  • Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements.
  • Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities.
  • Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure.

Financial Controls & Risk Management

  • Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership.
  • Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning.
  • Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals.
  • Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
  • MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions.
  • Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements.
  • Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations.
  • Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite.
  • Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs.
  • Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional \"fit and proper\" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.


Why Join VelaFi?

Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure.

As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil , you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations.


This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Impulsionados pela inovação e pelo foco em criar momentos de alegria por meio de alimentos e bebidas, nossas decisões são guiadas pela centralidade no consumidor, criando oportunidades para que nossos associados realizem um trabalho significativo e gerem um impacto duradouro nas comunidades que atendemos.Seja qual for o seu papel, você fará parte de uma comunidade global que valoriza suas ideias e o capacita a causar impacto, tanto em sua carreira quanto no mundo ao seu redor.A oportunidade - Responsável pelo planejamento, gestão e controle das operações comerciais no mercado onde atua, visando atingir as previsões de faturamento nos limites de despesas previstas no orçamento; - Planeja, organiza e gerencia as ações dos clientes sob sua responsabilidade, desenvolvendo estratégias e ações para alcançar e/ou superar os objetivos estabelecidos pela Cia., respeitando a política comercial e mantendo o crescimento sustentável de sua unidade de negócios; - Atingir periodicamente os objetivos de volume, respeitando as políticas comerciais, e metas internas da Companhia; - Manter a empresa informada sobre as ações de mercado, a fim de alimentar nossas ferramentas gerenciais e indicadores chave de performance; - Analisar regularmente as ferramentas internas disponíveis além dos demais relatórios diversos de kpi´s, fornecidos pelas áreas de apoio, conectando os dados com as análises de mercado obtidas de store check, visitas comerciais e relatórios Nielsen, para identificar oportunidades e propor soluções, formalizadas em um plano de ação; - Analisar os indicadores de performance do desempenho dos seus clientes para tomada de decisões; - Desenvolver a equipe sob sua responsabilidade direta seguindo o Modelo de Desenvolvimento de Carreira da PepsiCo.- Planejar e acompanhar as entregas, com negociações de volume adequadas às regras de palletização e com o melhor faseamento dentro do mês, contribuindo para solucionar/ eliminar dificuldades de entrega e devoluções de mercadorias; - Desenvolver o Modelo de Gestão Pepsico para sua região dentro da sua respectiva área de atuação, conhecendo adequadamente seu cliente e atuando como parceiro de negócio; - Desenvolver calendário de atividades promocionais alinhado com as estratégias da empresa, gerenciando acordos (contratos) comerciais para garantir o crescimento dos volumes negociados, bem como também fortalecer a parceria comercial; title: Analista de Design Gráfico Jr.
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Design Gráfico Jr. em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga CLT | Analista de Design Júnior | 100% Remoto


A Dreamland Holding , ecossistema que abriga marcas em plena ascensão como Dream Success e Conface Contabilidade , está em expansão e busca um(a) Analista de Design Júnior com foco em criação visual, desenvolvimento de peças gráficas e execução de projetos de design para múltiplas marcas e clientes.


Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que desejam crescer em um ambiente de alta exigência técnica , cultura meritocrática e profundo senso de propósito. Aqui, o foco é entregar, evoluir e transformar. Não há espaço para a cultura do menos esforço, baixa responsabilidade ou vitimismo .


🚀 Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) profissional com experiência real em design gráfico, que domine ferramentas digitais e consiga unir execução rápida, organização visual e atenção extrema aos detalhes .

  • Você atuará diretamente com as equipes da Dreamland Holding e suas empresas, atendendo tanto a holding quanto os clientes da Dream Success , criando artes para redes sociais, materiais digitais e projetos recorrentes, lidando com múltiplas demandas simultâneas.
  • É uma vaga para quem entende que clientes exigentes elevam o nível profissional e que crescimento acelerado exige ritmo intenso, disciplina e maturidade emocional.


Suas principais responsabilidades

  • Criar artes para redes sociais, campanhas, lançamentos e projetos institucionais;
  • Desenvolver Canva Packs e templates estratégicos para clientes e marcas do grupo;
  • Produzir peças gráficas diversas como posts, capas, apresentações e materiais digitais;
  • Criar books digitais e e-books , principalmente utilizando o Canva Pro ;
  • Atender múltiplos clientes e projetos simultaneamente, mantendo organização e padrão visual;
  • Adaptar layouts para diferentes marcas, respeitando identidade visual e brand books;
  • Garantir consistência estética, clareza visual e alto nível de acabamento nas entregas;
  • Cumprir prazos rigorosos em um ambiente de alto volume de demandas.


🧠 Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia como designer gráfico em empresa, agência ou projetos contínuos;
  • Domínio avançado de Canva Pro , com criações originais e refinadas, padrão high ticket;
  • Conhecimento prático no pacote Adobe como Photoshop, Illustrator e similares;
  • Conhecimento no Google G-Suite em nível intermediário ou avançado (uso frequente no dia a dia);
  • Equipamento próprio e estrutura adequada para trabalho remoto;
  • Autonomia, foco e capacidade de cumprir prazos com excelência;
  • Boa comunicação, senso estético e alta atenção a detalhes;
  • Perfil organizado, responsável e com alta atenção a detalhes.


Diferenciais que valorizamos

  • Experiência com criação de books digitais e e books ;
  • Vivência em holdings, agências ou ambientes de alta demanda;
  • Habilidades em criações visuais do scratch, especialmente do pacote Adobe como Illustrator, Photoshop e InDesign e Canva Pro ;
  • Ser heavy user de redes sociais , com repertório visual e entendimento de tendências;
  • Conhecimento e utilização de ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao design como diferencial;
  • Capacidade de lidar com feedbacks constantes e ajustes frequentes;
  • Perfil resiliente, organizado e orientado a entregas;
  • Vontade real de crescer profissionalmente e construir carreira de longo prazo.


⚙️ O que oferecemos

  • Vaga CLT em regime 100% remoto (de verdade);
  • Proposta Salarial Inicial de R$ 2.420,00 com aumento salarial meritocrático garantido em contrato a cada 3 meses;
  • Premiações e bônus por performance, pagos mensal e anualmente, conforme metas e entregas. Inclusive podendo alcançar até R$ 10.000,00 mensais e o 16º salário no ano.
  • R$ 600/mês em benefícios flexíveis via Caju Benefícios;
  • Adicional de R$100/mês por uso de equipamento próprio;
  • Rapidoc – acesso ao maior hub de telemedicina premium do Brasil – pago a você e 3 beneficiários a sua escolha;
  • Day-off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos, Pós Graduação e até inglês corporativo 100% custeado pela empresa, seguindo critérios meritocrático previamente estabelecidos;
  • Plano de carreira acelerado, com possibilidade de promoção em até 3 meses, conforme OKRs definidos em sua contratação;
  • Ambiente de trabalho focado em resultado, colaboração e leveza, onde acreditamos em valores familiares, bom humor e excelência profissional.


⚠️ Aviso Importante

  • Esta é uma vaga técnica, voltada a profissionais que sabem executar o briefing proposto acima. Não recomendado para primeiras oportunidades de trabalho, e sim, profissional com track-record comprovado.
  • Haverá uma fase prática obrigatória, na qual o candidato deverá comprovar suas habilidades reais de edição e criação.
  • Pedimos gentilmente que não se candidatem pessoas sem experiência comprovada nas ferramentas e entregas exigidas ou não concordantes com a realização obrigatória de teste prático.
  • E também reforçamos que a vaga não é indicada para freelancers ou profissionais que desejam permanecer como PJ. Buscamos alguém que queira crescer dentro da empresa, assumir responsabilidades maiores e evoluir rapidamente.


✨ Gostou da vaga? #PartiuDreamTeam


As inscrições serão realizadas exclusivamente pelo LinkedIn. Não serão aceitos currículos enviados por fora desta plataforma.


Se você se interessou, é simples:

  • Basta se candidatar aqui pelo LinkedIn e cadastrar seu currículo em PDF, obrigatoriamente contendo portfólio com peças gráficas que representem seu nível técnico e estilo visual.
  • Currículos enviados em outros formatos ou sem portfólio anexado serão automaticamente desconsiderados.


Desejamos boa sorte no processo seletivo!

E será um prazer conhecer melhor você e seu trabalho criativo!

title: TikTok Shop & E-commerce Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para TikTok Shop & E-commerce Lead em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview


We are looking for someone to own and scale our TikTok Shop and broader e-commerce ecosystem. This includes Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Walmart.com, Faire, and other e-commerce wholesale platforms. This is a senior, execution-focused role. We are not looking for someone to learn TikTok on the job. You must come in as a TikTok expert with a proven track record of driving revenue, and then extend that expertise across other channels.


Responsibilities


  • Own TikTok Shop end-to-end, including product listings, pricing, promotions, creator strategy, and storefront management
  • Drive revenue through TikTok Shop via both organic content and paid ads
  • Manage and scale creator and affiliate programs with a clear focus on sales, not just content output

  • Expand learnings from TikTok into Shopify, Amazon, Walmart.com, Faire, and wholesale platforms

  • Manage inventory flow across channels to prevent stockouts and overages
  • Analyze performance data and provide clear, actionable recommendations

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Site Reliability Engineer with 3+ years of experience in high-availability cloud environments using AWS to join our U.S. client. This role is heavily focused on AWS infrastructure, CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipeline ownership, with an emphasis on improving reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

This position is ideal for someone who operates with an engineering mindset, takes strong ownership, and is comfortable recommending and implementing improvements across infrastructure and pipelines. You will join a shared SRE/DevOps function, working closely with engineering teams to ensure scalable, secure, and cost-effective systems. The role also requires readiness to work within and manage Windows-based environments, as the client operates primarily on Windows infrastructure.

Our client provides industry-leading environmental compliance, fuel management, and facility maintenance software used by major fuel networks, including global brands. Their platform helps companies monitor and optimize operations by delivering real-time insights, automating compliance tasks, and ensuring site uptime.

With a mission to make sustainability and operational efficiency seamless, our client is transforming how fuel networks operate. As part of their dynamic, fast-paced engineering team, you'll have the opportunity to work on cloud-based, data-driven solutions that have a direct impact on performance, compliance, and environmental responsibility.


Responsibilities

  • Own and improve AWS-based infrastructure, with a strong focus on CloudFormation templates
  • Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and AWS integrations
  • Analyze and manage infrastructure costs, proactively identifying optimization opportunities
  • Work closely with engineering teams to reduce their dependency on writing CloudFormation templates, improve deployment processes and operational efficiency, and recommend and implement improvements across existing and new pipelines
  • Ensure proper monitoring, observability, and reliability standards before production releases
  • Support release processes, including availability during release windows when needed
  • Build and maintain reusable infrastructure and automation modules
  • Contribute to security best practices within cloud infrastructure
  • Collaborate in a safe Agile environment, participating in sprints and technical discussions


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years supporting a high-availability cloud environment in a DevOps, SRE, or Sysadmin role
  • Strong, hands-on experience with AWS and Azure
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines, particularly using Azure DevOps and AWS-native tools or integrations
  • Systems and infrastructure deployment and management practices
  • Readiness to work in and manage Windows-based environments
  • AWS Infrastructure & CloudFormation – Strong hands-on experience managing production AWS environments, with expertise in CloudFormation, networking, and high-availability infrastructure
  • Windows Server Administration – Experience administering and maintaining Windows Server environments, including patch management, troubleshooting, and production support
  • Windows Workloads in AWS/Azure – Proven experience deploying, managing, and supporting Windows-based workloads across AWS and/or Azure cloud environments
  • PowerShell & Automation – Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation, infrastructure management, and operational tasks
  • CI/CD & SRE Mindset – Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, incident response, and improving system reliability and operational efficiency
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Extensive networking skills, including VPC, VPN, TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, or DNS
  • Experience provisioning, deploying, and supporting containers with Helm, Kubernetes (Kops), or Docker
  • Scripting and development experience using Python, Go, or bash with associated source control
  • Hands-on monitoring tool usage, including AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, or similar tools
  • Experience with relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL, and document stores such as MongoDB
  • Microsoft Azure Cloud experience


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

🚀 Resumo do Cargo


O Analista de Visualização de Dados é um especialista dedicado a transformar dados brutos e complexos em narrativas claras, acionáveis e visualmente cativantes. Este cargo é focado no domínio do Tableau, exigindo alguém que não apenas crie painéis (dashboards) interativos, mas também projete os modelos de dados que os alimentam. O analista trabalhará em conjunto com estrategistas de clientes para definir KPIs, identificar tendências e comunicar insights que guiem decisões estratégicas. Embora o foco principal seja técnico, o entendimento de métricas de marketing e mídia é muito valorizado.


Responsabilidades Principais


  • Desenvolvimento Especializado de Dashboards: Liderar o design, criação e manutenção de relatórios interativos e de alto impacto no Tableau, garantindo que atendam aos padrões da marca e às necessidades do usuário.
  • Análise e Modelagem de Dados: Limpar, organizar e analisar conjuntos de dados de diversas fontes. Utilizar SQL para extrair e manipular dados para relatórios eficientes.
  • Storytelling Estratégico de Dados: Traduzir descobertas técnicas em formatos visuais (gráficos, mapas de calor) que forneçam recomendações claras para partes interessadas técnicas e executivas.
  • Levantamento de Requisitos: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes técnicas e as unidades de negócios, trabalhando com stakeholders para definir requisitos de relatórios e estabelecer KPIs relevantes.
  • Automação de Processos: Identificar e implementar oportunidades de automação no ciclo de vida dos relatórios para aumentar a eficiência.
  • Garantia de Qualidade (QA): Realizar validações rigorosas para garantir a precisão e integridade de todos os dashboards.
  • Relatórios Ad-Hoc: Fornecer análises rápidas para responder a perguntas urgentes de negócios ou solicitações de clientes.


✅ Qualificações e Requisitos


  • Graduação: Marketing, Business Analytics ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência Profissional: 2 a 5 anos de experiência prática em modelagem e visualização profissional de dados.
  • Domínio do Tableau: Proficiência avançada é obrigatória. É necessário demonstrar experiência profunda em criar pastas de trabalho complexas, usar expressões de Nível de Detalhe (LOD) e otimizar o desempenho de painéis.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente: É indispensável a habilidade de se comunicar com clareza e fluidez em inglês no dia a dia, tanto de forma escrita quanto em reuniões de vídeo.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Capacidade comprovada de interpretar grandes volumes de dados e identificar o impacto real por trás dos números.
  • Comunicação: Capacidade comprovada de apresentar insights de dados de forma simples e intuitiva, adaptando a linguagem técnica para as necessidades de negócio dos clientes.


⭐ Diferenciais


  • Tratamento de Dados (Data Wrangling): Experiência com SQL para extração, manipulação e lógica de cruzamento de dados (join).
  • Experiência em Marketing e Mídia: Familiaridade com análises de marketing (Ex: Google Analytics, Meta Ads, métricas de Search) e fluxos de agências de mídia.
  • Excel Avançado: Proficiência em fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas e Power Query.
  • Noções de Design: Olhar apurado para princípios de UI/UX aplicados ao layout de dashboards e teoria das cores.
