title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.
  • Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.
  • Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.
  • Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.
  • Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.


Engagement Terms

  • This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.
  • Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.
  • Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.
  • Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.

Você não vai fazer cold calling (ligação fria). Você receberá leads diários, já pré-aquecidos.   • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas B2C (seguros, consórcios, serviços de alto valor) ou como SDR.

  • Infraestrutura impecável de Home Office: Computador rápido, Webcam de qualidade, Microfone sem ruídos e ambiente profissional para videochamadas.
  • Postura acolhedora, mas comercialmente agressiva em bater metas.


A Proposta de Valor:

  • Ganhos Sem Teto: Fixo (R$ 2000,00) + Comissão Agressiva por diagnósticos vendidos e por cada contrato efetivamente fechado pelo Closer através do seu agendamento. Retirada média projetada de R$ 4.500,00 a R$ 5.500,00+.
  • Contratação formato PJ (MEI).
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto com autonomia.

Não queremos apenas o seu currículo. Queremos ouvir a sua voz e a sua energia.

Para completar a candidatura, envie para o WhatsApp um áudio de 1 minuto respondendo: \"Por que a sua experiência em vendas B2C o torna o SDR perfeito para lidar com a vida e o futuro de aposentados?\" (Candidatos que não enviarem o áudio serão automaticamente desclassificados).

SAP Regional Consultant – O2C / P2P / R2R / P2D-EWM


Location: Brazil - Remote

Employment Type: Full-time contractor

Monthly Compensation: Up to USD 8,700


About Us

Latam Digital Hub by Stefanini connects experienced technology professionals across Latin America with global digital transformation initiatives. Through its nearshore delivery model, the company provides specialized SAP, technology, and consulting services to international organizations.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Regional Consultant to support a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program within the automotive manufacturing industry. The consultant will provide senior functional expertise across multiple end-to-end business processes, including Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Deliver / Extended Warehouse Management.


This role requires broad SAP functional knowledge, hands-on configuration experience, strong cross-module integration capabilities, and the ability to support regional rollout activities in coordination with global template owners and local business stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide senior consulting and functional expertise across O2C, P2P, R2R, and P2D-EWM workstreams.
  • Lead or co-lead solution design workshops across process domains, adapting global templates to regional business requirements.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops to gather business requirements and map As-Is and To-Be processes.
  • Drive regional rollout activities across the Americas, coordinating with global template owners and local business stakeholders.
  • Perform hands-on configuration across SAP S/4HANA modules, including SD, MM, FI-CO, PP, and EWM.
  • Ensure effective cross-module integration across the complete supply chain and financial cycle.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to regional business leaders, Finance Directors, Supply Chain Managers, and Operations leaders.
  • Support System Integration Testing, User Acceptance Testing, and cutover planning across assigned workstreams.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of SAP functional experience across at least three of the following process areas: O2C, P2P, R2R, and P2D-EWM.
  • Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA core processes and integration points.
  • Hands-on configuration experience in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA across multiple modules.
  • Experience with SAP Activate methodology and global template deployment models.
  • Proven manufacturing industry experience.
  • At least one or two full lifecycle SAP implementations in a multi-module or program lead capacity.
  • Advanced or fluent English is mandatory.


Nice to Have

  • Automotive industry experience.
  • Experience working with US-based clients or US-led SAP programs.
  • Familiarity with North American business culture and stakeholder management styles.
  • Strong business analysis skills, including requirements gathering and gap analysis.
  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.


Why Join Us?

  • Join a leading global consulting firm specializing in digital transformation and SAP solutions.
  • Work with a diverse team across multiple regions, including the Americas, gaining unique local and global experience.
  • Opportunity to lead and influence regional rollout activities in a dynamic and innovative environment.
  • Receive monthly compensation of up to USD 8,700 through Deel.

title: R&D Documentation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para R&D Documentation Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About the Role

Kor Nutra is seeking a detail-oriented R&D Documentation Specialist to support our nutraceutical gummy research and development team. This role is critical to ensuring our formulation records, testing documentation, and regulatory compliance materials meet the rigorous standards required in a GMP-regulated dietary supplement manufacturing environment. You'll work closely with R&D scientists, Quality, and Regulatory teams to maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation across new product development and formulation projects.


Key Responsibilities
  • Create, review, and maintain R&D documentation including formulation records, batch development reports, stability study documentation, and analytical testing records
  • Draft and revise Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), specifications, and technical protocols in support of new product development
  • Ensure documentation complies with 21 CFR Part 111 (Dietary Supplement cGMPs) and other applicable food/supplement regulations
  • Maintain version control and organization of R&D documents within document management systems

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

If you live in Brazil, are fluent in English and want to build a global HR operation from scratch, we're looking for you!


About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States.


We're a remote-first team of 30+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy — and that's what we want to nourish with our Human Resources.


About the Opportunity

You will be Downtown's first HR hire, reporting directly to one of the founding partners, with the mission of building the People function from scratch. Our operation is distributed by design across Brazil, the US and India. We have doubled our team in 2026 (now 30+) and will keep growing at a fast pace, with a People strategic plan already approved by the founders.


For the first 12 months, this role will mix orchestration and execution: you will coordinate specialized recruiting agencies in the US, Brazil and India; manage payroll and benefits; design and manage development programs in direct partnership with the leadership across the world.


One detail defines this role: your main internal clients are in the US and India. Interviews, trainings, sensitive career conversations and negotiations with American vendors will happen in English, every day.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote, based in Brazil)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you'll do (major challenges for 2026)

A. People Operations across 3 countries

  • Map and stabilize payroll, benefits and employment flows in the US and India
  • Work alongside a BPO in India on hires, payroll calendar, SLAs


B. Training & Development

  • Coordinate technical training programs across the US and India
  • Design and coordinate a management development program that allows us to keep growing sustainably


C. Recruiting (outsourced execution)

  • Manage specialized recruiting agencies in search for technical positions
  • Build scorecards with hiring managers and document the selection process, preparing the future internalization of recruiting (with new HR hire)


Must-haves

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.
  • Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.
  • Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.
  • Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.
  • Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.


Engagement Terms

  • This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.
  • Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.
  • Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.
  • Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects.
  • Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives.
  • Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.


Application Note

This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

title: Analista de Visualização de Dados (Tableau)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Visualização de Dados (Tableau) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oportunidade: Analista de Visualização de Dados (Tableau) na UT-TECH

Modelo: PJ ou Cooperado, 100% remoto


🚀 Resumo do Cargo


O Analista de Visualização de Dados é um especialista dedicado a transformar dados brutos e complexos em narrativas claras, acionáveis e visualmente cativantes. Este cargo é focado no domínio do Tableau, exigindo alguém que não apenas crie painéis (dashboards) interativos, mas também projete os modelos de dados que os alimentam. O analista trabalhará em conjunto com estrategistas de clientes para definir KPIs, identificar tendências e comunicar insights que guiem decisões estratégicas. Embora o foco principal seja técnico, o entendimento de métricas de marketing e mídia é muito valorizado.


Responsabilidades Principais


  • Desenvolvimento Especializado de Dashboards: Liderar o design, criação e manutenção de relatórios interativos e de alto impacto no Tableau, garantindo que atendam aos padrões da marca e às necessidades do usuário.
  • Análise e Modelagem de Dados: Limpar, organizar e analisar conjuntos de dados de diversas fontes. Utilizar SQL para extrair e manipular dados para relatórios eficientes.
  • Storytelling Estratégico de Dados: Traduzir descobertas técnicas em formatos visuais (gráficos, mapas de calor) que forneçam recomendações claras para partes interessadas técnicas e executivas.
  • Levantamento de Requisitos: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes técnicas e as unidades de negócios, trabalhando com stakeholders para definir requisitos de relatórios e estabelecer KPIs relevantes.
  • Automação de Processos: Identificar e implementar oportunidades de automação no ciclo de vida dos relatórios para aumentar a eficiência.
  • Garantia de Qualidade (QA): Realizar validações rigorosas para garantir a precisão e integridade de todos os dashboards.
  • Relatórios Ad-Hoc: Fornecer análises rápidas para responder a perguntas urgentes de negócios ou solicitações de clientes.


✅ Qualificações e Requisitos


  • Graduação: Marketing, Business Analytics ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência Profissional: 2 a 5 anos de experiência prática em modelagem e visualização profissional de dados.
  • Domínio do Tableau: Proficiência avançada é obrigatória. É necessário demonstrar experiência profunda em criar pastas de trabalho complexas, usar expressões de Nível de Detalhe (LOD) e otimizar o desempenho de painéis.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente: É indispensável a habilidade de se comunicar com clareza e fluidez em inglês no dia a dia, tanto de forma escrita quanto em reuniões de vídeo.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Capacidade comprovada de interpretar grandes volumes de dados e identificar o impacto real por trás dos números.
  • Comunicação: Capacidade comprovada de apresentar insights de dados de forma simples e intuitiva, adaptando a linguagem técnica para as necessidades de negócio dos clientes.


⭐ Diferenciais


  • Tratamento de Dados (Data Wrangling): Experiência com SQL para extração, manipulação e lógica de cruzamento de dados (join).
  • Experiência em Marketing e Mídia: Familiaridade com análises de marketing (Ex: Google Analytics, Meta Ads, métricas de Search) e fluxos de agências de mídia.
  • Excel Avançado: Proficiência em fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas e Power Query.
  • Noções de Design: Olhar apurado para princípios de UI/UX aplicados ao layout de dashboards e teoria das cores.


Tem o perfil para esse desafio? Candidate-se e venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Veeva Support Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veeva Support Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS ? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment


We are looking for a Veeva Support Engineer .


In this role, you will:

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Regulatory Operations, IT Security, QA, Validation) to meet compliance and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, including SOPs, user manuals, knowledge base articles, and incident logs.
  • Participate in validation testing (IQ/OQ/PQ) and periodic system reviews within GxP-regulated environments.
  • Assist in system upgrades, patch testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to support uninterrupted business operations.
  • Proactively identify and drive opportunities for process automation, system optimization, and user experience enhancements.
  • Troubleshoot critical production issues, including system unavailability and data integrity problems, and propose resolutions or workarounds.
  • Replicate and diagnose issues using industry-standard tools and techniques (e.g., FTP, Postman, AWS tools), and propose solutions or workarounds.
  • Provide end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs platforms, including issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive system monitoring.


Platform & Tool Responsibilities:

  • Veeva API : Collaborate with the BOT development team to provide Veeva RIM API endpoints to support automation and system integration.
  • Learning Management: Contribute to the setup of the Veeva RIM Training module within the eLMS Quality Suite, enabling streamlined training compliance tracking.
  • PleaseReview: Serve as a technical point of contact for both standalone and Veeva-integrated PleaseReview applications, managing user access, configuration, performance optimization, and license management.
  • ISI Toolbox: Support the setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, ensuring proper installation, patching, and integration with internal systems.
  • Lorenz docuBridge: Manage the full lifecycle, including user provisioning and license management.
  • Lorenz iSubmit: Support installation, configuration, and issue resolution, ensuring compliance with internal and external submission standards.
  • Word Templates: Configure and support the Starting Point Template application used in regulatory document workflows.
  • iLovePDF: Install, configure, and troubleshoot iLovePDF and similar tools for high-volume regulatory document processing.
  • ServiceNow : Manage requests, incidents, and escalations, driving them through to resolution.


Mandatory Skills:

  • Fluent English.
  • Experience in the life sciences and healthcare industry.
  • Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and validation processes in regulated environments.
  • Strong technical skills in configuration and issue resolution within Windows-based enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow) and request/incident/change management processes.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus.

  • Compreensão aprofundada de arquiteturas de dados técnicos;
  • Grande capacidade na resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Sólido conhecimento em programação Java e serviços web;
  • Sólido conhecimento do SailPoint Identity IQ;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre integração de aplicativos utilizando conectores personalizados JDBC e WebServices;

  • Proficiente em PowerPoint, Word, Excel e Visio;

  • Analista Técnico de IAM Principais responsabilidades da função;
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão do tempo;
  • Sólido conhecimento em gestão de programas de segurança.

  • 3 anos de experiência em conceitos básicos de IAM: gerenciamento de identidade, autenticação, autorização, certificação, provisionamento, etc;
  • 3 anos de experiência técnica em soluções de IAM;

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation

  • Proven manufacturing industry experience.

Why Join Us?

  • Join a leading global consulting firm specializing in digital transformation and SAP solutions.
  • Work with a diverse team across multiple regions, including the Americas, gaining unique local and global experience.
  • Opportunity to lead and influence regional rollout activities in a dynamic and innovative environment.
  • Receive monthly compensation of up to USD 8,700 through Deel.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Site Reliability Engineer with 3+ years of experience in high-availability cloud environments using AWS to join our U.S. client. This role is heavily focused on AWS infrastructure, CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipeline ownership, with an emphasis on improving reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

This position is ideal for someone who operates with an engineering mindset, takes strong ownership, and is comfortable recommending and implementing improvements across infrastructure and pipelines. You will join a shared SRE/DevOps function, working closely with engineering teams to ensure scalable, secure, and cost-effective systems. The role also requires readiness to work within and manage Windows-based environments, as the client operates primarily on Windows infrastructure.

Our client provides industry-leading environmental compliance, fuel management, and facility maintenance software used by major fuel networks, including global brands. Their platform helps companies monitor and optimize operations by delivering real-time insights, automating compliance tasks, and ensuring site uptime.

With a mission to make sustainability and operational efficiency seamless, our client is transforming how fuel networks operate. As part of their dynamic, fast-paced engineering team, you'll have the opportunity to work on cloud-based, data-driven solutions that have a direct impact on performance, compliance, and environmental responsibility.


Responsibilities

  • Own and improve AWS-based infrastructure, with a strong focus on CloudFormation templates
  • Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and AWS integrations
  • Analyze and manage infrastructure costs, proactively identifying optimization opportunities
  • Work closely with engineering teams to reduce their dependency on writing CloudFormation templates, improve deployment processes and operational efficiency, and recommend and implement improvements across existing and new pipelines
  • Ensure proper monitoring, observability, and reliability standards before production releases
  • Support release processes, including availability during release windows when needed
  • Build and maintain reusable infrastructure and automation modules
  • Contribute to security best practices within cloud infrastructure
  • Collaborate in a safe Agile environment, participating in sprints and technical discussions


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years supporting a high-availability cloud environment in a DevOps, SRE, or Sysadmin role
  • Strong, hands-on experience with AWS and Azure
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines, particularly using Azure DevOps and AWS-native tools or integrations
  • Systems and infrastructure deployment and management practices
  • Readiness to work in and manage Windows-based environments
  • AWS Infrastructure & CloudFormation – Strong hands-on experience managing production AWS environments, with expertise in CloudFormation, networking, and high-availability infrastructure
  • Windows Server Administration – Experience administering and maintaining Windows Server environments, including patch management, troubleshooting, and production support
  • Windows Workloads in AWS/Azure – Proven experience deploying, managing, and supporting Windows-based workloads across AWS and/or Azure cloud environments
  • PowerShell & Automation – Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation, infrastructure management, and operational tasks
  • CI/CD & SRE Mindset – Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, incident response, and improving system reliability and operational efficiency
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Extensive networking skills, including VPC, VPN, TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, or DNS
  • Experience provisioning, deploying, and supporting containers with Helm, Kubernetes (Kops), or Docker
  • Scripting and development experience using Python, Go, or bash with associated source control
  • Hands-on monitoring tool usage, including AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, or similar tools
  • Experience with relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL, and document stores such as MongoDB
  • Microsoft Azure Cloud experience


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

A B2Brazil é a principal plataforma de negócios B2B da América Latina. title: Senior Lighting Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Lighting Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About the Role

Ideolux is a leading LED lighting company specializing in high-quality, project-grade lighting solutions for commercial, hospitality, retail, residential, and architectural projects. We are seeking an experienced Senior Lighting Designer to lead the development of innovative lighting concepts, manage project deliverables, and provide technical expertise throughout the design process.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the development of lighting concepts from design brief through project completion.
  • Prepare detailed lighting layouts, calculations, specifications, and technical documentation using Dialux Evo, AutoCAD, and related software .
  • Produce high-quality 2D and 3D lighting visualizations and client presentations.
  • Perform advanced photometric calculations and ensure compliance with international lighting standards and project requirements.
  • Select and specify luminaires based on design intent, technical performance, energy efficiency, and budget.
  • Collaborate with architects, interior designers, MEP consultants, and project managers to deliver integrated lighting solutions.
  • Review drawings and technical submissions to ensure accuracy and quality.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior lighting designers.
  • Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams to support project execution and resolve technical challenges.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, lighting technologies, and sustainable design practices.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in architectural lighting design or a similar role.
  • Advanced proficiency in Dialux Evo, AutoCAD , and Microsoft Office; experience with Revit, AGi32, Photoshop, SketchUp, or 3ds Max is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of lighting design principles, photometrics, controls, energy codes, and international lighting standards.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously and working with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in commercial, hospitality, retail, or large-scale architectural projects is highly preferred.
Working Hours (UAE Time)

Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM

Saturday: 9:30 AM – 12:30 PM

Sunday: Off

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

If you live in Brazil, are fluent in English and want to build a global HR operation from scratch, we're looking for you!


About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States.


We're a remote-first team of 30+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy — and that's what we want to nourish with our Human Resources.


About the Opportunity

You will be Downtown's first HR hire, reporting directly to one of the founding partners, with the mission of building the People function from scratch. Our operation is distributed by design across Brazil, the US and India. We have doubled our team in 2026 (now 30+) and will keep growing at a fast pace, with a People strategic plan already approved by the founders.


For the first 12 months, this role will mix orchestration and execution: you will coordinate specialized recruiting agencies in the US, Brazil and India; manage payroll and benefits; design and manage development programs in direct partnership with the leadership across the world.


One detail defines this role: your main internal clients are in the US and India. Interviews, trainings, sensitive career conversations and negotiations with American vendors will happen in English, every day.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote, based in Brazil)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you'll do (major challenges for 2026)

A. People Operations across 3 countries

  • Map and stabilize payroll, benefits and employment flows in the US and India
  • Work alongside a BPO in India on hires, payroll calendar, SLAs


B. Training & Development

  • Coordinate technical training programs across the US and India
  • Design and coordinate a management development program that allows us to keep growing sustainably


C. Recruiting (outsourced execution)

  • Manage specialized recruiting agencies in search for technical positions
  • Build scorecards with hiring managers and document the selection process, preparing the future internalization of recruiting (with new HR hire)


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken) — a hard requirement. This is not English for occasional meetings: you will run interviews, facilitate trainings, handle sensitive conversations and negotiate with US search firms in English, daily
  • 8-12 years of generalist HR experience
  • Experience at coordinator-to-manager level
  • Strong vendor management skills: BPOs, recruiting agencies, development consultancies
  • Autonomy to operate without a ready-made structure and maturity to work directly with founders
  • Availability to work across time zones: the India window falls in the Brazilian morning, and the US window in the afternoon


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience supporting internationally distributed teams
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction (AEC) industry
  • Prior experience as a first HR hire or building a People function from scratch


Selection Process

1. Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV

2. Screening: English and communication assessment (video)

3. Technical challenge

4. Interviews with leadership

5. Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work directly with founders
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales


PS: why Brazil? Our CEO is Brazilian and that's where most of our non-technical teams are based.

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.
  • Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.
  • Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.
  • Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.
  • Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.


Engagement Terms

  • This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.
  • Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.
  • Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.
  • Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects.
  • Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives.
  • Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.


Application Note

This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

If you live in Brazil, are fluent in English and want to build a global HR operation from scratch, we're looking for you!


About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States.


We're a remote-first team of 30+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy — and that's what we want to nourish with our Human Resources.


About the Opportunity

You will be Downtown's first HR hire, reporting directly to one of the founding partners, with the mission of building the People function from scratch. Our operation is distributed by design across Brazil, the US and India. We have doubled our team in 2026 (now 30+) and will keep growing at a fast pace, with a People strategic plan already approved by the founders.


For the first 12 months, this role will mix orchestration and execution: you will coordinate specialized recruiting agencies in the US, Brazil and India; manage payroll and benefits; design and manage development programs in direct partnership with the leadership across the world.


One detail defines this role: your main internal clients are in the US and India. Interviews, trainings, sensitive career conversations and negotiations with American vendors will happen in English, every day.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote, based in Brazil)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you'll do (major challenges for 2026)

A. People Operations across 3 countries

  • Map and stabilize payroll, benefits and employment flows in the US and India
  • Work alongside a BPO in India on hires, payroll calendar, SLAs


B. Training & Development

  • Coordinate technical training programs across the US and India
  • Design and coordinate a management development program that allows us to keep growing sustainably


C. Recruiting (outsourced execution)

  • Manage specialized recruiting agencies in search for technical positions
  • Build scorecards with hiring managers and document the selection process, preparing the future internalization of recruiting (with new HR hire)


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken) — a hard requirement. This is not English for occasional meetings: you will run interviews, facilitate trainings, handle sensitive conversations and negotiate with US search firms in English, daily
  • 8-12 years of generalist HR experience
  • Experience at coordinator-to-manager level
  • Strong vendor management skills: BPOs, recruiting agencies, development consultancies
  • Autonomy to operate without a ready-made structure and maturity to work directly with founders
  • Availability to work across time zones: the India window falls in the Brazilian morning, and the US window in the afternoon


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience supporting internationally distributed teams
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction (AEC) industry
  • Prior experience as a first HR hire or building a People function from scratch


Selection Process

1. Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV

2. Screening: English and communication assessment (video)

3. Technical challenge

4. Interviews with leadership

5. Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work directly with founders
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales


PS: why Brazil? Our CEO is Brazilian and that's where most of our non-technical teams are based.

title: Social Media Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Account Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The compensation for this full time contract role is a target pay of $693 USD per month . We have a performance-based advancement system that can lead to increased compensation over time.


About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.


We specialize in working with growing brands in CPG, services, and personal brands. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.


At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role

Oversees daily management, execution, and results of assigned internal and external social media accounts. Develop detailed content calendars, scripts for content production, edit content, and ensure strategic alignment with organizational goals. Directly responsible for achieving engagement, growth, and metrics on assigned accounts.


Responsibilities

  • Manage content scheduling, posting, engagement, and growth strategies of assigned social media accounts.
  • Develop comprehensive calendars and content tailored specifically to each account.
  • Write detailed scripts for video and content recordings, aligned with strategic goals.
  • Edit and refine social media content ensuring clarity, accuracy, and brand consistency.
  • Own accountability for achieving established performance metrics on all assigned accounts.
  • Communicate proactively, ensuring content alignment with objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with team for strategies.
  • Analyze account performance, adjusting content strategies for optimal results.


Results

  • Achievement of established KPIs (engagement, growth, reach) on managed social media accounts.
  • Strategic, engaging, and error-free content consistently published.
  • Effective scripts and content calendars leading to enhanced content quality and engagement.
  • Improved audience engagement, growth, and overall performance metrics.


Requirements

  • Strong social media management experience and editing skills.
  • Excellent written communication and scripting abilities.
  • AI systems and agents familiarity.
  • Proficiency with social media management tools.
  • Data-driven approach to content strategy, editing, and performance optimization.
  • Proven ability in achieving clear performance metrics across multiple accounts.
  • Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized.
  • Results-focused, proactive, and strategic.
  • Collaborative team player with strong internal communication skills.


The compensation for this full time contract role is a target pay of $693 USD per month . We have a performance-based advancement system that can lead to increased compensation over time.

title: Analista de Customer Success Junior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Customer Success Junior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Júnior para ajudar nas rotinas de atendimento e suporte, com a possibilidade de participar de projetos de automação e análise de dados no dia a dia. Queremos uma pessoa proativa e organizada que será crucial na otimização da experiência dos nossos clientes, realizando o monitoramento de métricas de sucesso e na proposição de melhorias contínuas em nossos processos, sempre com foco em garantir a satisfação e o sucesso dos nossos clientes.


Quem Somos:

A B2Brazil é a principal plataforma de negócios B2B da América Latina. Nossa missão é auxiliar as Micro e Pequenas Empresas (MPEs) brasileiras a acessarem novos mercados nacionais e internacionais, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de seus negócios. Visamos nos tornar a principal plataforma de negócios entre o Brasil e o mundo, atuando de maneira inovadora, eficaz e com soluções acessíveis.


Sobre a equipe

O time de Customer Success cuida de toda a jornada dos nossos usuários na plataforma, do primeiro contato até o pós-venda, garantindo que eles extraiam a melhor experiência possível com nossas ferramentas e serviços. Estamos em um momento de transformação, migrando tarefas operacionais para fluxos automatizados e assistidos por Inteligência Artificial, o que permite ao time dedicar mais tempo a análises estratégicas e à experiência do cliente como um todo.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar o autoatendimento, atender e dar suporte a clientes (compradores e vendedores) da plataforma através dos canais oficiais (chat, WhatsApp, e-mail) em casos de escalonamento para agente ao vivo.
  • Auxiliar na validação de documentos e processos de verificação de contas comerciais
  • Gerenciamento de perfis, produtos, negociações e demais informações disponibilizadas na plataforma 
  • Acompanhar processos de onboarding e ongoing, revisando e contribuindo para a melhoria da experiência do usuário com a plataforma
  • Contribuir para a manutenção e atualização da base de conhecimento utilizada por clientes e pelos agentes de atendimento (incluindo o agente de IA da empresa)
  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de automação nos processos de atendimento
  • Apoiar campanhas e iniciativas de comunicação com clientes, incluindo conteúdos multilíngues (português, inglês e espanhol)
  • Monitorar indicadores de qualidade e satisfação do atendimento (NPS, CSAT, tempo de resposta, taxa de resolução)
  • Colaborar com outras áreas (Marketing, Comercial) para resolver demandas e melhorar a experiência do cliente


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Marketing ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prévia (estágio ou efetivo) em Customer Success/Experience, atendimento ao cliente, suporte ou áreas correlatas
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação)
  • Espanhol intermediário é um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto
  • Pacote Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) em nível intermediário


Skills desejadas

  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado para comunicação profissional (escrita e conversação)
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas
  • Facilidade para lidar com ferramentas digitais e novas tecnologias
  • Interesse por automação, IA aplicada a atendimento e análise de dados
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resolução de problemas
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração multifuncional
  • Habilidade de negociação e argumentação.
  • Conhecimento básico de comércio exterior (Incoterms, RFQ, processos de importação/exportação) é um diferencial


Detalhes da Vaga

  • Regime de contratação: CLT (Efetivo)
  • Nível: Júnior / Entry Level
  • Salário: R$ 2.300,00
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto (Home Office)


Benefícios

  • Horário de trabalho flexível com ingresso entre 08:00 e 10:00. 
  • Relacionamento direto e sem burocracia com todos os colaboradores e diretores da empresa. 
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Gympass
  • Day off no aniversário

title: Analista de Visualização de Dados (Tableau)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Visualização de Dados (Tableau) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oportunidade: Analista de Visualização de Dados (Tableau) na UT-TECH

Modelo: PJ ou Cooperado, 100% remoto


🚀 Resumo do Cargo


O Analista de Visualização de Dados é um especialista dedicado a transformar dados brutos e complexos em narrativas claras, acionáveis e visualmente cativantes. Este cargo é focado no domínio do Tableau, exigindo alguém que não apenas crie painéis (dashboards) interativos, mas também projete os modelos de dados que os alimentam. O analista trabalhará em conjunto com estrategistas de clientes para definir KPIs, identificar tendências e comunicar insights que guiem decisões estratégicas. Embora o foco principal seja técnico, o entendimento de métricas de marketing e mídia é muito valorizado.


Responsabilidades Principais


  • Desenvolvimento Especializado de Dashboards: Liderar o design, criação e manutenção de relatórios interativos e de alto impacto no Tableau, garantindo que atendam aos padrões da marca e às necessidades do usuário.
  • Análise e Modelagem de Dados: Limpar, organizar e analisar conjuntos de dados de diversas fontes. Utilizar SQL para extrair e manipular dados para relatórios eficientes.
  • Storytelling Estratégico de Dados: Traduzir descobertas técnicas em formatos visuais (gráficos, mapas de calor) que forneçam recomendações claras para partes interessadas técnicas e executivas.
  • Levantamento de Requisitos: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes técnicas e as unidades de negócios, trabalhando com stakeholders para definir requisitos de relatórios e estabelecer KPIs relevantes.
  • Automação de Processos: Identificar e implementar oportunidades de automação no ciclo de vida dos relatórios para aumentar a eficiência.
  • Garantia de Qualidade (QA): Realizar validações rigorosas para garantir a precisão e integridade de todos os dashboards.
  • Relatórios Ad-Hoc: Fornecer análises rápidas para responder a perguntas urgentes de negócios ou solicitações de clientes.


✅ Qualificações e Requisitos


  • Graduação: Marketing, Business Analytics ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência Profissional: 2 a 5 anos de experiência prática em modelagem e visualização profissional de dados.
  • Domínio do Tableau: Proficiência avançada é obrigatória. É necessário demonstrar experiência profunda em criar pastas de trabalho complexas, usar expressões de Nível de Detalhe (LOD) e otimizar o desempenho de painéis.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente: É indispensável a habilidade de se comunicar com clareza e fluidez em inglês no dia a dia, tanto de forma escrita quanto em reuniões de vídeo.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Capacidade comprovada de interpretar grandes volumes de dados e identificar o impacto real por trás dos números.
  • Comunicação: Capacidade comprovada de apresentar insights de dados de forma simples e intuitiva, adaptando a linguagem técnica para as necessidades de negócio dos clientes.


⭐ Diferenciais


  • Tratamento de Dados (Data Wrangling): Experiência com SQL para extração, manipulação e lógica de cruzamento de dados (join).
  • Experiência em Marketing e Mídia: Familiaridade com análises de marketing (Ex: Google Analytics, Meta Ads, métricas de Search) e fluxos de agências de mídia.
  • Excel Avançado: Proficiência em fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas e Power Query.
  • Noções de Design: Olhar apurado para princípios de UI/UX aplicados ao layout de dashboards e teoria das cores.


Tem o perfil para esse desafio? Candidate-se e venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Monitoreo de Redes (CCNA) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

¡Buscamos un Analista de Monitoreo de Redes (CCNA) para Brasil!

Si cuentas con experiencia en monitoreo de redes, gestión de incidentes, hablas español fluido y te interesa formar parte de la operación de servicios de telecomunicaciones, queremos conocerte.


Requisitos excluyentes

  • Formación técnica o profesional en Telecomunicaciones, Redes, Sistemas o carreras afines.
  • Al menos 1 año de experiencia en NOC, monitoreo de redes o centros de operaciones.
  • Certificación CCNA vigente o conocimientos equivalentes.
  • Conocimientos en TCP/IP, Routing, Switching, VLAN, OSPF, BGP, DHCP y herramientas de monitoreo.
  • Experiencia en gestión y escalamiento de incidentes bajo cumplimiento de SLA.
  • ¨Dominio oral y escrito del idioma español a nivel fluido o avanzado. El cargo requiere interacción permanente en español con clientes y equipos de trabajo, por lo que no es suficiente comprender el idioma; es indispensable poder comunicarse verbalmente en español de manera fluida.¨


Principales responsabilidades

  • Monitorear infraestructura y servicios de telecomunicaciones.
  • Gestionar y escalar incidentes de acuerdo con procedimientos establecidos.
  • Asegurar la disponibilidad y continuidad operacional de los servicios.
  • Coordinar la comunicación con equipos técnicos y clientes durante la gestión de incidentes.

Modalidad: Remota

Ubicación: Brasil


Si buscas nuevos desafíos y quieres desarrollarte en un entorno tecnológico y dinámico, te invitamos a postular y ser parte de nuestro equipo.

title: Professor Assistente - Telecomunicações
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor Assistente - Telecomunicações em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Detalhamento do perfil: O profissional será responsável por acompanhar a evolução dos alunos;  esclarecer duvidas e prestar assistência;  acompanhar as avaliações teóricas e práticas dos alunos no âmbito do sistema da avaliação de educação profissional - saep;  acompanhar e orientar os alunos no desenvolvimento de projetos/protótipos e trabalhos de final de curso;  acompanhar e registrar aproveitamento a frequência dos alunos, utilizando instrumentos/ferramentas disponibilizados pela entidade;  identificar novas metodologias, recursos e procedimentos didáticos para apoiar o processo de ensino aprendizagem;  elaborar plano de aula e material didático de acordo com os conhecimentos e capacidades pertinentes a unidade curricular;  identificar as melhoresformas de avaliar o desempenho dos alunos, elaborar, aplicar e corrigir as avaliações realizadas;  identificar e desenvolver roteiros de práticas para consolidar a aprendizagem dos alunos;  identificar e requisitar os recursos necessários ao desenvolvimento das atividades e ao adequado aproveitamento dos alunos;  identificar possíveis oportunidades de negócios em empresas onde estiver atuando;  ministrar as aulas de acordo com o planejamento elaborado;  participar da organização e realização de eventos, elaborar e executar apresentações, nas unidades e em empresas clientes;  participar das reuniõesde planejamento da unidade curricular sob sua responsabilidade, bem como das reuniões de coordenação do curso;  realizar os registros necessários para acompanhamento dos alunos e do cursoDescrição da vaga:Salário (R$ 10.789,00) + Benefícios (Plano de Saúde, Aux. Alimentação, Aux. Transporte, entre outros)Vínculo de trabalho: EfetivoCarga Horária: 40h (Segunda a Sexta - 13h às 22h)Requisitos da VagaEscolaridade: Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica e MestradoConhecimentos técnicos e experiência exigida: Experiência na área de Telecomunicações e Ensino;  Experiência em Docênciano Nível Superior nas áreas de Princípios de comunicações, telecomunicações, projeto de antenas, ondas eletromagnéticas e propagação de sinaisConhecimentos desejáveis: Doutorado na área de Telecomunicações e Ensino

title: Talent Data Analyst - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Data Analyst - Remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.Overview of the role:We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.Key responsibilities:- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.- Maintain and document the operational environment.Requirements:- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).- Advanced English level.Benefits:
- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.
- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.
- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.
- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.
- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.
- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.
- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.
- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!
